$comment: ORRERY open morphospace — authored source of truth. node scripts/lifegrammar.mjs regenerates vr/sim/lifeGrammar.js. Nothing here is Earth-specific by construction: option lists are open, integer axes are unbounded above by biology rather than by an enum.

options.why: Where the body sits in the medium. Ancestral state is the vent floor because that is where chemical disequilibrium is free.
How thrust is made. Ambulacral and peristaltic exist because five-fold and hydrostatic bodies do not walk on limbs.
Oxidant delivery. Every entry is a different scaling law between surface and volume, which is why this axis sets a mass ceiling.
How the next body is built and where the risk is spent.
What carries load. Silica and calcite are separate entries because the ocean can be undersaturated in one and not the other.
Where the energy comes from before anything is spent on shape.
The boundary layer — what it costs to hold water in, heat in, and teeth out.
Nothing can use a sensor it cannot process. This axis gates every imaging organ in organs.json.
Whether body temperature is a consequence of the world or a defended set point.
Group structure changes the unit selection acts on, which is why it is an axis and not a flag.

integers.why: Order of rotational symmetry about the oral–aboral axis. 0 is no axis at all — goo. 1 is one mirror plane, which is what Earth calls bilateral. 5 is what you get when a pentameral larva never picks a front, and a pentaradial animal has five equally good directions to move in, so it has no head.
Serial repeats along the main axis. Set by a segmentation clock against a growth wavefront, so it is a ratio of two rates rather than a number anyone types.
Appendage pairs per expressing segment. On a radial body the appendages come in `symmetryOrder` sets, not pairs, and the expression code knows that.
How many of the segments actually grow appendages. A centipede and a beetle differ in this number and in nothing else structural.
Terminal elements per appendage. Five is a frozen accident on Earth; eight is what the earliest tetrapods had.
0 sac, 1 blind gut, 2 through-gut. A through-gut is what lets a body eat and digest at the same time and it is the single largest jump in feeding rate in the record.
Genome copies. Whole-genome duplication is the cheapest route to new organs because a duplicate is free to diverge.
log10 body mass in grams, offset by 4: 0 is 0.1 µg, 4 is 1 g, 10 is 1 t, 14 is 10 kt. Never locked — mass is the axis that responds fastest to oxygen, gravity and island area.
